name: MedCP
description: Medical Model Context Protocol Server for Claude Desktop
long_description: MedCP is a specialized medical AI extension that integrates electronic health record databases and large-scale biomedical knowledge graphs directly into Claude Desktop. It enables natural language querying of clinical data (SQL Server, MySQL/MariaDB, or a local SQLite file — e.g. OMOP CDM), exploration of the SPOKE biomedical knowledge graph (Neo4j), and comprehensive analysis combining patient records with drug-disease associations, protein interactions, and biological pathways. Claude Desktop stores configuration values marked sensitive in the operating-system keychain; database queries still travel to the database endpoints you configure.

tools.name: get_knowledge_graph_schema
tools.description: List all nodes, their attributes and their relationships in the biomedical knowledge graph. This provides the schema for drug-disease associations, protein interactions, pathways, and other biomedical entities. Requires APOC plugin to be installed and enabled.

tools.name: query_knowledge_graph
tools.description: Execute a read-only Cypher query on the biomedical knowledge graph for fast knowledge inference. Supports queries for drug-disease associations, protein interactions, pathways, and other biomedical relationships.

tools.name: query_clinical_records
tools.description: Execute a READ-ONLY SQL query on electronic health records for rapid clinical data retrieval. Works against SQL Server, MySQL, or a local SQLite file. Only SELECT queries are allowed for security and data integrity.

tools.name: list_clinical_tables
tools.description: List all available clinical data tables in the electronic health records database. Returns table schema, name, type, and full qualified name for each table.

prompts.name: biomedical_knowledge_inference
prompts.description: Query biomedical knowledge graph to find drug-disease associations, protein interactions, and pathways
prompts.text:
I need to analyze biomedical relationships in the knowledge graph. Please help me:
1. First, show me the knowledge graph schema to understand available nodes and relationships
2. Query for drug-disease associations for a specific condition
3. Find protein interactions related to the identified drugs
4. Identify relevant biological pathways

Please start by showing me the available node types and relationships in the biomedical knowledge graph.

prompts.name: clinical_data_analysis
prompts.description: Analyze electronic health records for clinical insights
prompts.text:
I want to analyze clinical data from the electronic health records. Please help me:
1. First, list all available clinical tables to understand the data structure
2. Query patient demographics and basic statistics
3. Analyze specific clinical outcomes or conditions
4. Cross-reference findings with biomedical knowledge if needed

Please start by showing me what clinical data tables are available.

prompts.name: integrated_medical_analysis
prompts.description: Combine clinical records with biomedical knowledge for comprehensive medical analysis
prompts.text:
I need to perform an integrated analysis combining clinical data with biomedical knowledge. Please help me:
1. Examine clinical records for patterns related to a specific condition
2. Query the biomedical knowledge graph for relevant drug-disease associations
3. Find protein targets and pathways associated with identified drugs
4. Provide insights that combine both clinical observations and biomedical knowledge

Let's start by exploring both the clinical data structure and biomedical knowledge schema.

KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH_URI.title: Knowledge Graph URI (optional — for your OWN Neo4j)
KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH_URI.description: Leave blank to use the bundled SPOKE production graph automatically (no credentials needed). Set this ONLY to point at your own Neo4j / compatible knowledge graph, e.g. bolt://your-neo4j-host:7687

KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH_USERNAME.title: Knowledge Graph Username (your Neo4j)
KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH_USERNAME.description: Username for YOUR Neo4j knowledge graph. Not needed for the default SPOKE graph.

KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH_PASSWORD.title: Knowledge Graph Password (your Neo4j)
KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH_PASSWORD.description: Password for YOUR Neo4j knowledge graph. Not needed for the default SPOKE graph.

KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH_DATABASE.title: Knowledge Graph Database Name (your Neo4j)
KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH_DATABASE.description: Database name on YOUR Neo4j knowledge graph. Not needed for the default SPOKE graph.

MEDCP_DISABLE_KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH.title: Disable Knowledge Graph
MEDCP_DISABLE_KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH.description: Disable the bundled SPOKE graph and expose EHR tools only.

CLINICAL_RECORDS_BACKEND.title: EHR Backend (optional)
CLINICAL_RECORDS_BACKEND.description: Electronic health record SQL engine: 'sqlite' (local file), 'mysql' (MySQL/MariaDB), or 'mssql' (SQL Server). Leave the EHR fields blank to run MedCP as a SPOKE-only tool with no clinical database.

CLINICAL_RECORDS_SERVER.title: EHR Server host (mysql / mssql)
CLINICAL_RECORDS_SERVER.description: Hostname of YOUR MySQL or SQL Server EHR database. For the mysql/mssql backends only.

CLINICAL_RECORDS_DATABASE.title: EHR Database name (mysql / mssql)
CLINICAL_RECORDS_DATABASE.description: Name of YOUR MySQL or SQL Server EHR database. For the mysql/mssql backends only.

CLINICAL_RECORDS_USERNAME.title: EHR Username (mysql / mssql)
CLINICAL_RECORDS_USERNAME.description: Username for YOUR MySQL or SQL Server EHR database. For the mysql/mssql backends only.

CLINICAL_RECORDS_PASSWORD.title: EHR Password (mysql / mssql)
CLINICAL_RECORDS_PASSWORD.description: Password for YOUR MySQL or SQL Server EHR database. For the mysql/mssql backends only.

CLINICAL_RECORDS_PORT.title: EHR Port (mysql / mssql, optional)
CLINICAL_RECORDS_PORT.description: TCP port of YOUR MySQL (3306) or SQL Server (1433) EHR database. Optional.

CLINICAL_RECORDS_SQLITE_PATH.title: EHR SQLite file path (sqlite)
CLINICAL_RECORDS_SQLITE_PATH.description: Absolute path to a local SQLite EHR database file. For the sqlite backend only (no server or credentials needed).

MEDCP_NAMESPACE.title: MedCP Namespace
MEDCP_NAMESPACE.description: Tool namespace prefix for MedCP tools (optional)

MEDCP_LOG_LEVEL.title: Log Level
MEDCP_LOG_LEVEL.description: Logging level for MedCP server (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR)
